sloka: स तत्र न्यवसद्भ्रात्रा सह सत्कारसत्कृतः ।मातुलेनाश्वपतिना पुत्रस्नेहेन लालितः ॥२-१-२॥
transliteration: sa tatra nyavasadbhrātrā saha satkārasatkṛtaḥ ।mātulenāśvapatinā putrasnehena lālitaḥ ॥2-1-2॥

translations.english: Treated with warm hospitality and fatherly affection by his maternal uncle Aswapati, Bharata stayed on there along with his brother.
